provider: CityUHK JS1221 BSc Computer Science and BSc Computational Finance and Financial Technology double degree curriculum
note: The official JS1221 admissions page publishes a five-year, 151-credit double-degree structure and names 17 unique coded University, College-specified and College/School courses. It separately requires 99 Major credits: 33 from CS core, 30 from CFFT core, 33 serving as Core or Electives for both Majors, and one 3-credit CS elective, but does not publish the corresponding double-degree Major course list. The current CFFT catalogue corroborates titles and individual credits for the named CFFT-side and University courses; the official two-page double-degree leaflet confirms the Programme identity and duration but contains no curriculum table. Standalone CS and CFFT Major pools are not copied into the double degree. The verified 17-course partial list is therefore browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and must not produce a graduation-completion percentage.
